user.title: Add a tty7 host
user.description: Create a read-only, local-only POST webhook. Use the verified HTTPS Home Assistant base URL reachable by your collector. No Home Assistant API token is needed. Notifications are optional and can target only an existing Companion mobile-app action or persistent notifications.

data.label: Host display label
data.base_url: Verified HTTPS Home Assistant base URL
data.notify_waiting: Notify when an agent needs input
data.notify_completion: Notify when an agent finishes or fails
data.retain_inventory: Allow inventory and its private names in Home Assistant restore storage

data_description.notification_title_template: Plain text, up to 1024 characters; line breaks become spaces. Default: {session_name}, using an approved fresh tab name, then a ready native OMP full name or stock derived label, otherwise Unnamed session. Available fields: session_name, event_message, host_label, host_id, agent, pane_id, session_id, status, event (needs input, completed or failed), event_type (needs_input, completed or failed), model, effort, permission_mode, tab_name, workspace_name. Other missing values are empty; explicitly empty effort becomes None. Names require a fresh, consistent, names-approved unique pane/tab/workspace join; native names and derived labels need derived-label consent. Double braces are literal. No expressions, attribute/index access, conversions, format specifications or Home Assistant state access.
data_description.notification_message_template: Default: {event_message}: Finished., Needs your input. or Failed. Up to 1024 characters with the title's fields. Your text is trusted Markdown for persistent notifications or HTML for Companion; inserted values are escaped first and line breaks become spaces. Missing values stay empty except session_name (Unnamed session); explicitly empty effort becomes None. Only approved fresh joined names are available. The dashboard link and Companion click action are preserved. Double braces are literal; no Jinja, state, command, URL or credential placeholders.
data_description.retain_inventory: Off by default. Inventory is still displayed live. Enabling this explicitly allows workspace/tab/group names, derived labels and approved native session names to be saved locally across Home Assistant restarts. It never restores fresh health. Disable to remove inventory and native names from subsequent restore writes.

pairing.title: Pair your collector privately
pairing.description:
Wire host ID: `{host_id}`

Secret webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`

Save this bearer credential only in the collector's private settings file. Do not put it in a dashboard, screenshot, log or repository. Keep certificate and hostname verification enabled. Requests are POST-only and restricted to local networks by Home Assistant. Finish setup before starting the collector. You can view this information again in Configure.

error.invalid_host_id: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
error.invalid_label: Enter a 1–64 character label without line breaks or control characters.
error.invalid_base_url: Enter an HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments. The collector must trust its certificate and hostname.
error.invalid_destination: Choose no notifications, persistent notifications, or an existing Companion mobile-app action.
error.invalid_dashboard: Enter a local path such as /lovelace/agents using letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and slashes.
error.invalid_notification_template: Use at most 1024 characters with only documented named fields in single braces or doubled literal braces. Expressions, attribute/index access, conversions and format specifications are not allowed.

abort.already_configured: This wire host ID is already configured.
abort.credential_redaction_capacity: The process-lifetime credential privacy limit has been reached. Restart Home Assistant before adding another host.

init.title: Configure host and notifications
init.description: Changing settings reloads this host and reconfirms its notification baseline. Its wire host ID and private credential stay fixed; remove the host to revoke the credential. Inventory names are received only with collector consent. Keeping them across Home Assistant restarts requires separate restore-storage consent below.
